The problem

Mirrors, the group chat and generic style quizzes all tell you something. None of them tell you what to change.

The loop

Three steps. One straight answer.

01

Snap your outfit

One full-length photo. No quiz, no measurements to type in.

02

Get the honest read

It names fit, proportion, footwear, layering and colour — one line, with a rating out of five.

03

Restyle it on you

Swap a piece and see the better version rendered on your own photo — not a model.

The editor

Change one piece.
See it on you.

Pick a slot — top, bottom, shoes, accessories — and cycle alternatives. Each swap renders on your own photo, so you judge the real thing, not a mood board.

digitized.

Add the clothes you own — Looktok turns each piece into a clean product shot and builds looks from what's already in your closet.

Why the read is trustworthy

Proof, not adjectives.

You first, brands second

The verdict is about you — your build, your palette, your wardrobe. Brands enter only when a piece genuinely fits the look.

Specific, not cruel

A sharp friend, not a troll and not a flatterer. It leads with what works.

Every note ships a fix

No critique without a concrete, wearable way to make it better.

A rating out of five

Five stars for a look that lands, fewer when it doesn't — one honest read.
